# Raleway fonts served locally

Unmodified Raleway v37 WOFF2 files, downloaded from Google's font service on
2026-11-17. These variable-font files supply the normal 400 and 700 weights used
by the Readable stylesheet underlying Plum. Font outlines and quality are
unchanged; Latin, extended Latin, Vietnamese, Cyrillic and extended Cyrillic
subsets are retained.

The CSS snapshot came from:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Raleway:wght@400;700&display=swap

Each WOFF2 came from `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/raleway/v37/` followed by its
unchanged filename. Only CSS source URLs were rewritten to relative local paths.
`font-display: swap` keeps fallback text visible while local fonts load.

License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.txt. Upstream project:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/raleway

No Google service is contacted at runtime. To update, retrieve a complete CSS
snapshot and all its referenced files, retain the license, rewrite URLs locally
and run the offline asset tests. Clear browser caches after deploying updates.
